cycles.method: MKII on OS 1.40C, RAM base 06e08f35c62c02ce, Grain package ff105b4615e339742a60241c7ab7b1c10e68bc3dd585cf33a3a9a13fa9d49d5f. A render is one guarded T1 call inside a 16-sample frame. At 264 MHz the whole-frame deadline is 95,782 cycles. Reset the track timers with cpu and read mw_frame_cost_max[0] and [8] after each six-second window. Across three triggered settings the longest first call took 14,628 ticks and the longest second call took 17,201 ticks at 132 MHz (34,402 CPU cycles). These elapsed times include the stock Flex render, Grain and any interrupts. This is an observed maximum for one stereo 16-bit sample. A static bound and 24-bit hardware measurements remain open.

load.method: MKII B16 Part 1, T1 SYNC at 140 BPM with a stereo 16-bit, 88,200-frame sample. All eight tracks had both FX slots set to NONE throughout each comparison. With all 16 trigs removed and then restored, mean frame-interrupt load was 26.6/58.0% (SQR), 26.7/58.4% (NORM) and 26.7/59.2% (shorter NORM). The guard reported zero skips. The previous package measured 26.7/60.3% in the matched SQR setup. The loaded package was present in both windows. The stock-image load comparison under the prescribed MIDI traffic remains outstanding.

stress.droppedExplanation: No MIDI path. Two Grain tracks played for several minutes on the author's MKI with the pattern running and parameters turned, scenes and the crossfader moved and LFOs on the SRC knobs, with no hang reported and no skipped render counted by the base's frame guard. This is the author's report, not a stress run with a fixed duration.
